header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Place Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Ahead for Khilaafah, Are Pleased to Select him and Condemn Anyone who desires to Divide their Unity

blocks.text: (referring to the clan of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)). By Allaah! If you wish, I could fill Madinah with cavalry and infantry (to oppose Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA))." Hadhrat Ali (RA) responded by saying, "For as long as you wish to bear enmity for Islaam and its people, Abu Sufyaan, you will not be able to harm them in the least. We have found Abu Bakr (RA) to be worthy of the post." [^1]
The Differences between Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) Concerning the Khilaafah of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)

Hadhrat Sakhar (RA) who was Rasulullaah ﷺ's bodyguard[^2] narrates that Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed bin Aas (RA) was in Yemen when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away. He arrived in Madinah a month after Rasulullaah ﷺ's demise wearing a silken cloak. When he met Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Ali (RA), Hadhrat Umar (RA) called out to the people, "Tear up his cloak! How can he wear silk when he is a Muslim man in times of peace?" After the people had torn his cloak up, Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) said, "O Abu Hasan (Hadhrat Ali (RA))! O family of Abd Manaaf! Have you been overpowered in leadership?" Hadhrat Ali (RA) said to him, "Do you view this as a power struggle or Khilaafah?" Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) said, "O family of Abd Manaaf! No person better than you should overpower you in this matter (how could you allow Abu Bakr (RA) do so when he does not belong to the family of Abd Manaaf?)." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said to Hadhrat Khaalid (RA), "May Allaah smash your mouth! By Allaah! If any liar contemplates on what you have mentioned, he will do harm only to himself." [^3]
A Narration of Hadhrat Ummu Khaalid (RA) Concerning what Happened between Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA)

Hadhrat Ummu Khaalid (RA) who was the daughter of Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) narrates that her father returned from Yemen only after the Muslims had already pledged their allegiance to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). Addressing Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA), he said, "Do you people who are from the family of Abd Manaaf accept that a person who does not belong to your clan should be appointed as your leader?" When Hadhrat Umar (RA) reported this to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) ignored it while it remained in the heart of Hadhrat Umar (RA). Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) continued staying in Madinah for three months without pledging his allegiance to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA).
When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) once passed by the house of Hadhrat Khaalid bin
Rasulullaah ﷺ used bodyguards during a while, but then stopped using them when Allaah revealed verse 67 of Surah Maa'idah where Allaah says, "Allaah shall protect you from the people".
Tabari (Vol.4 Pg.28). Sayf and Ibn Asaakir have also reported the narration in brief, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.8 Pg.59).
